pos.title: Point of Sale
pos.desc: A fast POS that runs on tablet, phone, or desktop. Offline-ready and syncs automatically the moment you're back online.

customers.title: Customer Management

testimonials.title: Real businesses, real results
testimonials.subtitle: From small cafes to retail chains — here's what switching to SaleForges felt like.

one.quote: I used to run 4 different apps for checkout, stock, and reporting. Now it's all on one screen — and the reports show up automatically every morning without any manual work.

offline.a: Yes. Offline POS mode keeps recording transactions when the connection drops, then syncs everything automatically once you're back online — so checkout never stops.

setup.q: How long does setup and data migration take?
setup.a: Most single-outlet businesses go live the same day. For multi-branch setups, our onboarding team helps import product, stock, and customer data — usually 1–3 business days.

multi.q: Can I manage multiple branches at once?
multi.a: Yes. Manage stock, sales, and reports across every branch from one dashboard. Each outlet has its own data, but you still see the big picture in real time.

payment.a: QRIS, debit/credit cards, popular e-wallets, and bank transfers — all in one checkout flow with transparent settlement.

security.a: Data is encrypted both in transit and at rest, with role-based access control. Enterprise plans get a dedicated SLA and data residency options.

switch.q: Can I switch plans or cancel anytime?
switch.a: Absolutely. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime with no penalty. No binding contracts on Starter and Growth plans.

cta.title: Ready to unify your business?
cta.subtitle: Book a 20-minute demo and see for yourself how SaleForges simplifies your day-to-day operations.

footer.desc: An all-in-one commerce platform that unifies POS, inventory, payments, automation, and analytics in a single ecosystem.
